title: IARPA request to study CRISPR-Cas9 DNA data encoding

tellings.quote: the current deputy director dni Stacy Dixon was the director when I was asked could I take a look at using CRA crisper cast 9 encoding information into DNA

plain: Around 2013, a CIA contractor named Bob Maguire says he was asked to look into using CRISPR-Cas9, a gene-editing tool, to encode information into DNA. He tells Michels the request came while Stacy Dixon was director of IARPA, the research-funding arm of the US intelligence agencies, and that she is now deputy to the Director of National Intelligence, the official over all US spy agencies; the story places the work at the Hume Center at Virginia Tech. If true, it shows intelligence interest in storing data in living code.
